title: Deeper/broader ACadSharp AcDs reader maturity and offset-edge refresh
mode: primary-source web research and read-only local plan/source reconciliation
scope: Refresh released versus unreleased ACadSharp Prototype1b, blob01, and modeler-writer capabilities
Reconcile the peer's ObjectDataAlignmentOffset edge with current generated local coverage
Refine PAR-07/S8.3 and the composed comparator gate without expanding per-slice validation

method.kind: Read official project release, PR, issue, and documentation pages; inspect local DataStorage parser and generated test owner
method.limitations: ACadSharp corpus/hash results are contributor reports, not independently reproduced. A stale secondary segment-index report in PR #1154 does not establish general producer validity or current release behavior. The configured local ODA PDF at ~/doc/dwg/OpenDesign_Specification_for_.dwg_files.pdf was not present at the checked path; no DWG parser behavior was changed and no online-versus-local specification conflict was resolved.

sources.revision: Release page reviewed 2026-10-18; v3.8.0 commit 3a1c66b; v3.7.16 commit 3feabba
sources.observed: The latest tagged release is v3.8.0, whose release note is assembly visibility. The preceding v3.7.16 release notes include merged Prototype1b/ACIS read changes. This identifies a candidate read artifact, not writer or semantic qualification.

PR #1154 adds full Prototype1b section parsing and handle-addressed DataStorage access. Its discussion reports payload-hash agreement for 3,715 referenced handles and resolution of blob01 pages, including reported 14 MB/13-page bodies. PR #1156 closed after its blob01 page work was covered by the merged resolver. These are contributor/maintainer results and were not independently reproduced.

sources.project: ACadSharp section alignment and stale index discussion
sources.observed: An initial directory-rounding approach disagreed with the header ObjectDataAlignmentOffset anchor; later branch changes used the explicit anchor. A reported correlation with record counts divisible by four was later qualified by observations of eight-record files both with and without extra padding. A separate stale secondary segidx path was reported to over-read; its exact validity and current-release handling were not established here.

sources.project: ACadSharp modeler writer and schema refactor
sources.revision: Pages reviewed 2026-10-18; #1240 and #1174 remain open in reviewed state
sources.observed: Issue #1195 reports DXF writer omission on ACadSharp 3.4.9. PR #1240 proposes modeler-entity writing but is open, undeployed, and depends on #1174. PR #1174 is an open schema/storage refactor; its branch has a reported unfinished DXF ACDS record path. Neither branch is a released writer comparator.

The stock DXF/DWG route is documented as limited to 2D for proprietary ACIS modeler data and DWG uses a selected external converter. This corroborates the current 2D consumer versus ACIS semantic boundary; it is not a runtime result.

The parser derives the data-region base from the segment's checked objectDataAlignmentOffset. testDataStorageBlobPages already has a two-record case where the data start is anchored at relative offset 112 rather than a guessed 96, with unsorted offsets and sentinel payloads; it does not cover the reported four-record directory edge.

assessment.planImpact: Refines existing PAR-07/S8.3 and optional comparator readiness. ACadSharp v3.8.0 is admitted only as a candidate structural reader for handle-addressed AcDs data; its open modeler-writer branches are excluded. Add one generated four-record ObjectDataAlignmentOffset control at the next existing S8.3 touch, keep stale secondary-index handling conditional on the local ODA copy and producer evidence, and preserve the 2D-only stock FreeCAD consumer boundary.

implementationReadyChecks: When S8.3 is next edited, add one in-memory four-record control with explicit objectDataAlignmentOffset, extra padding, unique handle/payload pairs, permuted index order, and a following sentinel; do not encode a count-based data-start rule.

Keep stale secondary segidx as a separate conditional case. First consult the mandated local ODA PDF and establish a producer/profile witness; never swallow an over-read or partially publish payloads.

At the composed checkpoint only, pin ACadSharp v3.8.0, verify the exact artifact includes merged PR #1154, and compare handle-addressed DataStorage results, not an assumed ModelerGeometry.AcisData duplicate.
Exclude open #1240/#1174 writer branches from release-level comparison until a tagged release and fresh independent output read exist.
Keep stock FreeCAD qualification on the explicitly selected 2D converter/importer route; run any 3D plugin/kernel as a separate, named route.
